title: Advisory on Safe Use of WhatsApp Web:
body:
* Risk: Unauthorized WhatsApp Web sessions can let others read/send messages, access contacts and chats, impersonate you, and misuse your identity for fraud or phishing. 
* Avoid sensitive work: Don't share official, financial, or confidential info on WhatsApp Web.

 * Don't stay logged in: Manually log out after every session—closing the tab/window isn't enough.
 
* Use Incognito/Private mode only on trusted systems if needed, and log out manually before closing.
 
* Skip public/shared computers (cyber cafes, kiosks, hotels, borrowed devices).
 
* Stay alert & secure: Watch for unusual activity and keep your OS, browser, and security software updated while avoiding suspicious/cracked downloads.
